entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this useless piece of junk you call a VeloBand. I've had it for a month and it's terrible. I want my money back, now.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Peterson. Order number is VF77819. Don't give me the runaround, just process the refund. This is ridiculous.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now... I see you purchased the VeloBand GPS Tracker. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It doesn't matter! I don't like it, it doesn't do what I want, and your company's return policy better be decent or I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet. Is that specific enough for you?

I understand your frustration, Mark. I'm just trying to see if there's anything I can solve for you. But if you'd simply like to proceed with a return, let me check the eligibility based on your delivery date.
You do that. And if you tell me no, I want to speak to your manager immediately. This whole experience has been a waste of my time and money.
Okay, one moment please... I'm reviewing your order details and our current policy. I see here that the VeloBand was delivered to you 32 days ago.
Yeah, so? Are you going to try and tell me it's too late or something? Unbelievable.

Not at all, sir. According to our policy, VeloFit offers a 90-day return window for the VeloBand GPS Tracker. You are well within that timeframe, so I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh. Ninety days? Seriously? Well... okay then. That's... good. So you're approving it?

Yes, it's approved. I've just initiated the process. I'm sending you a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box with the device inside, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Wow, okay. That's actually a lot easier than I expected. Thank you, Diana. I appreciate you handling that so quickly.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just the return. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Have a great rest of your day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
